However, it fails the strict color/iridescence checkpoints from the taxonomy prior (white tail instead of iridescent). This is likely a breed variation rather than a generation failure, so the alignment score remains moderate-high. The occlusion of legs prevents full anatomical verification.

Visually, this manifests as soft, painterly textures in the hackles and a structurally collapsed/merged secondary chicken in the foreground. The background fence also shows slight geometric waviness. These are not catastrophic failures of the main subject but indicate noticeable generation artifacts, particularly in secondary elements and fine texture definition.
